summary: Join us for a family treasure hunt like no other at Bruce’s Mill. Explore the beautiful trails and work together to search for the hidden treasure using a map, riddles, and clues. Our treasure hunt will take you on a journey through the outdoors where you’ll discover unique natural wonders, and maybe even some beautiful birds. Bring your hiking shoes (or winter boots) and a sense of adventure!
title: Trail of Treasures at Bruce’s Mill
description: Join us for a family treasure hunt like no other at Bruce’s Mill. Explore the beautiful trails and work together to search for the hidden treasure using a map, riddles, and clues. Our treasure hunt will take you on a journey through the outdoors where you’ll discover unique natural wonders, and maybe even some beautiful birds. Bring your hiking shoes (or winter boots) and a sense of adventure! Timeslots: 10:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. Price: $75 per family (2-4 individuals) $15 extra per additional person REGISTER FOR THE EVENT! *All ticket sales are final. In the event of extreme weather, participants will be contacted with a notice of cancellation and issued a full refund. TRCA is committed to creating an accessible experience for all participants. If you require accommodation, please email simone.granieri@trca.ca at least 7 days prior to the event.
